summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to the 2026/27 season with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with a first-half goal from Tatters proving decisive. The Bach secured all three points while keeping a clean sheet in what was described as a battling performance against a resilient opponent. Player sponsor Calibre Control also backed another match-winning display, with Stan Tat receiving their support following the impressive opening day result.
